_comment: Widget registry — the single source of truth for addressable widgets (design/widget-system.md, 'First-Class Widgets'). Read by JS hosts (fetch) and Rust (include_str!). System trust tier ONLY: every page here ships in the app bundle; content-tier widgets (artifacts) never appear in this file and open via open_artifact_widget instead. `kind` is the name users, the hub launcher, and the agent all use; `description` is written for the agent directory (Phase 3).
